import Mathlib
import Aesop
set_option maxHeartbeats 2000000
set_option autoImplicit false
open BigOperators Real Nat Topology Rat

theorem quadratic_unique_minimizer
  (f : ℝ → ℝ)
  (hf : f = fun x => x^2 - 14 * x + 3) :
  ∀ x, IsMinOn f Set.univ x ↔ x = 7 := by
  have h_f_def : ∀ (x : ℝ), f x = x^2 - 14 * x + 3 := by
    intro x
    rw [hf]
    <;> simp [hf]
    <;> ring_nf
    <;> norm_num
  
  have h_f_7 : f 7 = -46 := by
    have h₁ : f 7 = (7 : ℝ)^2 - 14 * (7 : ℝ) + 3 := by
      rw [h_f_def]
      <;> norm_num
    rw [h₁]
    <;> norm_num
  
  have h_main_ineq : ∀ (x : ℝ), f x ≥ f 7 ∧ (f x = f 7 ↔ x = 7) := by
    intro x
    have h₁ : f x = x^2 - 14 * x + 3 := h_f_def x
    have h₂ : f 7 = -46 := h_f_7
    have h₃ : f x - f 7 = (x - 7)^2 := by
      rw [h₁, h₂]
      ring_nf
      <;>
      (try norm_num) <;>
      (try linarith)
    have h₄ : f x ≥ f 7 := by
      have h₄₁ : (x - 7 : ℝ)^2 ≥ 0 := by nlinarith
      linarith
    have h₅ : (f x = f 7 ↔ x = 7) := by
      constructor
      · 
        intro h₅₁
        have h₅₂ : (x - 7 : ℝ)^2 = 0 := by
          linarith
        have h₅₃ : x - 7 = 0 := by
          nlinarith
        linarith
      · 
        intro h₅₁
        rw [h₅₁]
        <;> norm_num [h_f_7]
        <;> linarith
    exact ⟨h₄, h₅⟩
  
  have h_forward : ∀ (x : ℝ), IsMinOn f Set.univ x → x = 7 := by
    intro x hx
    have h₁ : f x ≥ f 7 ∧ (f x = f 7 ↔ x = 7) := h_main_ineq x
    have h₂ : f x ≤ f 7 := by
      have h₃ : IsMinOn f Set.univ x := hx
      have h₄ : (7 : ℝ) ∈ Set.univ := by trivial
      have h₅ : f (7 : ℝ) ≥ f x := h₃ (by trivial)
      linarith
    have h₃ : f x = f 7 := by linarith
    have h₄ : x = 7 := by
      have h₅ : f x = f 7 ↔ x = 7 := h₁.2
      have h₆ : f x = f 7 := h₃
      have h₇ : x = 7 := by
        exact (h₅.mp h₆)
      exact h₇
    exact h₄
  
  have h_backward : ∀ (x : ℝ), x = 7 → IsMinOn f Set.univ x := by
    intro x hx
    have h₁ : x = 7 := hx
    have h₂ : IsMinOn f Set.univ x := by
      rw [h₁]
      
      intro y _
      have h₃ : f y ≥ f 7 := by
        have h₄ : f y ≥ f 7 ∧ (f y = f 7 ↔ y = 7) := h_main_ineq y
        exact h₄.1
      exact h₃
    exact h₂
  
  have h_final : ∀ (x : ℝ), IsMinOn f Set.univ x ↔ x = 7 := by
    intro x
    constructor
    · 
      intro h
      exact h_forward x h
    · 
      intro h
      exact h_backward x h
  
  exact h_final

import Mathlib
import Aesop
set_option maxHeartbeats 2000000
set_option autoImplicit false
open BigOperators Real Nat Topology Rat

theorem quadratic_unique_minimizer
  (f : ℝ → ℝ)
  (hf : f = fun x => x^2 - 14 * x + 3) :
  ∀ x, IsMinOn f Set.univ x ↔ x = 7 := by
  simp [hf, IsMinOn, ← sub_eq_zero]
  simp [IsMinFilter, sub_eq_zero]
  refine' fun y => ⟨fun h => _, fun h x => _⟩
  nlinarith [h 7, h (7 + (y - 7)), h (7 - (y - 7))]
  nlinarith [sq_nonneg (x - 7), sq_nonneg (y - 7), h]

import Mathlib
import Aesop
set_option maxHeartbeats 2000000
set_option autoImplicit false
open BigOperators Real Nat Topology Rat

theorem quadratic_unique_minimizer
  (f : ℝ → ℝ)
  (hf : f = fun x => x^2 - 14 * x + 3) :
  ∀ x, IsMinOn f Set.univ x ↔ x = 7 := by
  intro x
  simp only [hf]
  constructor
  · 
    intro h
    have h₁ : IsMinOn (fun x : ℝ => x ^ 2 - 14 * x + 3) Set.univ x := h
    
    have h₂ : x = 7 := by
      by_contra h₃
      
      have h₄ : x ^ 2 - 14 * x + 3 > (7 : ℝ) ^ 2 - 14 * (7 : ℝ) + 3 := by
        
        have h₅ : x ≠ 7 := h₃
        have h₆ : (x - 7) ^ 2 > 0 := by
          apply sq_pos_of_ne_zero
          intro h₇
          apply h₅
          linarith
        nlinarith [h₆]
      
      have h₇ : (fun x : ℝ => x ^ 2 - 14 * x + 3) x > (fun x : ℝ => x ^ 2 - 14 * x + 3) (7 : ℝ) := by
        simpa using h₄
      have h₈ : (fun x : ℝ => x ^ 2 - 14 * x + 3) x ≤ (fun x : ℝ => x ^ 2 - 14 * x + 3) (7 : ℝ) := by
        apply h₁
        exact Set.mem_univ _
      linarith
    exact h₂
  · 
    intro h
    rw [h]
    intro y hy
    simp only [Set.mem_univ]
    norm_num [sq_nonneg, add_assoc] at *
    <;>
    (try ring_nf) <;>
    (try nlinarith [sq_nonneg (y - 7)]) <;>
    (try linarith)
    <;>
    (try
      {
        cases' le_or_lt y 7 with h₁ h₁ <;>
        nlinarith [sq_nonneg (y - 7)]
      })
